# Matter Settle

> Matter Settle is an AI engineering studio based in India. A small team of engineers designs, builds and runs production AI systems end to end: data pipelines, models, the application around them, deployment and monitoring. It is a new studio with no public client case studies, and it says so. Matter Settle is not a legal, claims or settlement service.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mattersettle.com/): what the studio builds, who it is for, the terms of an engagement, how to get in touch.
- [How we build](https://mattersettle.com/work/): the engineering standard the studio works to and the terms it puts in writing.
- [Privacy](https://mattersettle.com/privacy/): what the site does with data. No analytics, no tracking, no third-party requests.

## What the studio builds

- Decision systems: reinforcement learning and simulation for problems where a wrong action costs real money, including reward design, risk constraints and honest evaluation.
- Data pipelines that run unattended: ingestion, validation and storage with quality gates and multi-source fallback.
- The application around a model: services, storage, deployment, dashboards and the tests that keep it releasable.
- LLM features built around one specific task, with an evaluation set so a change can be judged better or worse.
- Models that must run on constrained hardware: smaller models with measured latency and memory budgets.

## Terms of an engagement (as stated on the site)

- A written scope before any money moves: deliverable, price and what "done" means. If AI is the wrong tool, the studio says so.
- A fixed-price, fixed-scope paid pilot.
- Your code in your repository and your cloud accounts from the first commit.
- Something runnable every week, not a status deck.
- A pilot you can walk away from: you keep everything produced.
- Direct access to the engineer doing the work.

## Contact

- Email: settleyourmatter@gmail.com
- Location: India, IST (UTC+5:30). Working hours overlap a full European working day and US mornings.

## Linked projects

Matter Settle links to two public projects as examples of careful measurement. They are separate projects with their own sites: not Matter Settle products, not client work, and not a credential.

- [RLAlphaLabs](https://rlalphalabs.com/): AI trading research on Indian equities.
- [Porchlamp](https://pctablet505.github.io/porchlamp/): ranks open-source projects by how they treat pull requests from outsiders.
